description: The typed entity-reference value of docs/modeling-authoring.md §5.4 — the ONE reader/writer of the stored JSON shape {type, id, display, snapshotAt}. TryParse reads a stored value, ToJsonElement writes it, FromLookupItem builds a newly picked one (a fresh snapshotAt) and Label is the fallback ladder display -> id -> type. Shared by the schema validator, the inspector and a host writer, so the shape cannot drift.
